headline: Nigeria Cabotage Vessel Fund Held in Naira Rather Than Dollars, Official Says
summary: A former director of the Nigerian Maritime Administration and Safety Agency revealed that the Cabotage Vessel Financing Fund is maintained in domestic naira rather than US dollars.
why: Currency denomination of domestic maritime funds determines the purchasing power available to local shipping firms purchasing foreign-built vessels amid naira currency fluctuations.

impacts.name: Nigerian Maritime
impacts.why: Holding maritime intervention funds in depreciating naira weakens capacity to finance dollar-priced vessels.
